license_required.quote: No person may engage in or transact any home inspection business, or hold himself or herself out to the public as a home inspector, or offer to engage in or transact any home inspection business in this state unless the person is licensed by the Appraisal Board.

type.quote: This chapter shall be administered and enforced by the Mississippi Real Estate Appraisal Board, which shall have the duties and powers to: Receive applications for licensure as a home inspector under this chapter

age_minimum.quote: Be at least twenty-one (21) years of age;

moral_character_required.quote: An applicant found by the Appraisal Board to possess a background which calls into question the applicant's ability to maintain public trust shall not be issued a home inspector license.

required.quote: Each person who applies for renewal of his or her license shall successfully complete home inspector continuing education courses approved by the Appraisal Board at the rate of twenty (20) hours every two (2) years.

available.quote: A home inspector license may be issued to a home inspector from another state who satisfies one (1) of the following requirements:

requirements.value: Must hold a valid certificate of certification, registration or home inspector license in good standing issued by another state with substantially identical requirements, OR have passed the examination offered by the American Society of Home Inspectors or the National Association of Home Inspectors.
requirements.quote: holds a valid certificate of certification, registration or home inspector license in good standing issued by another state, which has requirements for licensure substantially identical to those of this state, or has passed the examination offered by the American Society of Home Inspectors or the National Association of Home Inspectors.

authority.quote: The Home Inspector Regulatory Board shall advise the Mississippi Real Estate Appraisal Board or its designee on all matters relating to this chapter.

insurance_required.quote: All home inspectors are required to carry general liability insurance and errors and omissions insurance.

definition_quote.value: the process by which a home inspector examines the observable systems and components of improvements to residential real property that are readily accessible
definition_quote.quote: "Home inspection" means the process by which a home inspector examines the observable systems and components of improvements to residential real property that are readily accessible.

license_tier.quote: No person may engage in or transact any home inspection business, or hold himself or herself out to the public as a home inspector, or offer to engage in or transact any home inspection business in this state unless the person is licensed by the Appraisal Board.

errors_and_omissions_insurance_required.quote: All home inspectors are required to carry general liability insurance and errors and omissions insurance.

general_liability_minimum_coverage.quote: Insurance coverage limits shall be no less than Two Hundred Fifty Thousand Dollars ($250,000.00) for general liability

value: performing repairs on a residential building as part of or result of the home inspection
prohibited_conflict_of_interest_practice.quote: No licensed home inspector may perform repairs on a residential building as part of or result of the home inspection.

liability_waiver_clauses_void.quote: Any condition, stipulation or provision binding any person engaging the services of a home inspector to waive compliance with any provision of this chapter or any rule or order hereunder is void.

statute_of_limitations_years.quote: An action by a client to recover damages for any act or omission of a home inspector relating to a home inspection that he conducts shall be commenced within three (3) years after the date a home inspection is completed or the action shall be barred.

approved_exam_bodies.quote: has passed the examination offered by the American Society of Home Inspectors or the National Association of Home Inspectors.

entity_license_required.quote: No license shall be issued under the provisions of this chapter to a partnership, association, corporation, limited liability company or partnership, firm or group.

residential_unit_maximum.quote: "Residential real property" means a structure intended to be, or that is in fact, used as a residence and consisting of one (1) to four (4) family dwelling units.
